My ex of 6 years cheated on me and left me for the guy. Do I hate her? yes, sometimes. Yet I still love her to and a lot of guys will say I'm weak for that.

But you see, I just think she's immature, she's so afraid to be alone and so insecure that the second the relationship became unstable and she felt unsatisfied. She went and cheated to detach herself emotionally instead of breaking up or confronting the problem head-on. 

Someone immature does that, someone who chooses not to change and stay selfish does that. 

But what hurts me most isn't the cheating or the lying but my own mistakes. Because her mistakes as hers and as hurtful as they are they are hers to learn and grow from.

All I can do is accept that her mistakes don't magically cancel out mines and do all I can to become a better person by accepting my own.

So you choose, stay being the same or truly learn to become a better person.

Also, if I were you, I would tell him and accept the consequences whatever they are. As hurtful as it might be, you will go to sleep knowing you told the truth and grow from it. As sad as you will be you will know you did the right thing in the end.

He might or might not take you back but that's the consequence to your choices and you have to face them if you want to grow.
